notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «جميعا عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد», so the Zuhri and the back-reference close both routes (rule 3)
«ابن رافع» in the second route is written bare; it is kept as the text writes it and not merged with «محمد بن رافع» in the first (rule 9)
«نحو حديث ابن عيينة» names another transmitter for the same saying, so it is a variant group and not a route (rule 4)
«غير أن في، حديث معمر» and «ولم يرخص له» are wording differences, left out
